arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Cassidy argued the Pledge does not violate the Establishment Clause. He stated the Ninth Circuit decision was incorrect. He claimed acknowledging religion's role is not an endorsement.
Mr. Olson argued the father lacks the right to sue. He stated the father has no independent legal right. He claimed the father cannot challenge his daughter's education conditions.
Mr. Newdow argued the Pledge violates the Constitution. He stated his daughter is required to stand and recite it. He maintained the school's policy is unconstitutional.
